plugins.name: software-framework
plugins.description: Software engineering meta-router — 15 frameworks (Scientific Debugging, Bisection, Observability, Hexagonal, DDD, Event Sourcing/CQRS, Modular Monolith, SOLID, 12-Factor, Resilience Patterns, Strangler Fig, Team Topologies, OWASP Security, CI/CD Basics, API Design). Built on real Korean growth scenarios (Toss, Kakao, Coupang, Naver) and regulatory context (FSC, 전자금융업, PG). Invoke /code.

skills.name: api-design
skills.description: API Design — REST principles, HTTP methods, status codes, error handling, versioning, pagination, rate limiting. Clean API contracts that other developers (and your future self) can actually understand.
headings: Client Errors (4xx — it's the caller's fault)
Server Errors (5xx — it's the server's fault)
GraphQL vs REST — When to Choose
skills.description_zh: 指导 REST API 设计，涵盖 HTTP 方法、状态码、错误处理、版本、分页和限流，形成清晰可理解的接口契约。

skills.name: bisection
skills.description: Bisection — git bisect, binary search, delta debugging. Isolate 'one cause among N candidates' in log N steps. Regression hunting, outage window narrowing, minimal reproducer input discovery.
headings: Found the culprit commit in 10 steps out of 1000 commits
skills.description_zh: 用 git bisect、二分搜索和 delta debugging，在多个候选中以对数级步骤定位原因，适用于回归排查、缩小故障时间窗及发现最小复现输入。

skills.name: cicd-basics
skills.description: CI/CD Basics — Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment fundamentals. GitHub Actions, Docker basics, deployment strategies (blue-green, canary), environment management. The minimum viable DevOps for solo developers and small teams.
headings: GitHub Actions — The Minimum Viable CI
Start from an official base image
Set working directory inside the container
Copy dependency files first (Docker caches this layer)
Copy the rest of the code
What to run when the container starts
Run a container from the image
Why bother with Docker for a solo project?
skills.description_zh: 介绍持续集成部署基础，包括 GitHub Actions、Docker、蓝绿及金丝雀部署和环境管理，面向独立开发者及小团队的基本运维。

skills.name: code
skills.description: Software engineering meta-router — auto-selects from 15 frameworks (debugging, architecture, design, resilience, evolution, team topology, security, CI/CD, API design). Real Korean growth scenarios (Toss, Kakao, Coupang, Naver), Korean financial regulatory context (FSC, 전자금융업, PG integration), legacy replacement, and team expansion. Includes anti-pattern warnings, stage-based defaults, and the Inverse Conway Maneuver.
headings: Measurable outcome proposal (1 number to move within 6 months)
skills.description_zh: 作为软件工程分流入口，从十五种调试、架构、设计、韧性、演进、团队、安全、CI/CD 和 API 框架中选择，结合韩国企业增长及金融监管背景、遗留替换和团队扩张，提供反模式提示、阶段默认和逆康威策略。

skills.name: ddd
skills.description: Domain-Driven Design (Eric Evans) — tackles complex business domains through language, boundaries, and models. Strategic (bounded context, context map, ubiquitous language) + Tactical (entity, value object, aggregate, domain event).
headings: Common Failures in the Korean Context
What to Use With This Framework
skills.description_zh: 通过领域驱动设计的语言、边界和模型处理复杂业务，涵盖战略层限界上下文、上下文映射、统一语言，以及实体、值对象、聚合和领域事件。

skills.name: event-sourcing-cqrs
skills.description: Event Sourcing + CQRS (Greg Young) — store events instead of state; state is a fold of events. Separate write and read models. Powerful for financial ledgers, auditing, time travel, and offloading read workloads.
headings: Triggers in the Korean Financial Context
Payment Systems like Toss and KakaoPay
What to Use Alongside This Framework
skills.description_zh: 使用事件溯源与 CQRS，将事件而非当前状态作为存储依据，由事件折叠得到状态并分开读写模型。适用于财务账簿、审计、历史回溯和读负载分离。

skills.name: hexagonal
skills.description: Hexagonal Architecture (Ports & Adapters) — Alistair Cockburn. Isolate domain logic from I/O (DB, HTTP, queues, UI). Testability, replaceability, technology independence.
skills.description_zh: 按六边形架构的端口与适配器，将领域逻辑与数据库、HTTP、队列及 UI 分离，提高可测试性、可替换性和技术独立性。

skills.name: modular-monolith
skills.description: Modular Monolith — an architecture that enforces strict module boundaries within a single deployment unit. Shopify and Basecamp case studies. The benefits of boundaries without the complexity of microservices. A safe starting point for future separation.
headings: When to Split into Microservices (Start with Reasons Not to Split)
Frameworks That Pair with This One
skills.description_zh: 在单个部署单元内建立严格模块边界，结合 Shopify 和 Basecamp 案例分析模块化单体，兼顾边界收益及未来拆分，避免过早承担微服务复杂性。

skills.name: observability
skills.description: Observability — Infer internal system state from external signals using USE (Gregg) + RED (Wilkie) + Four Golden Signals (Google SRE). 3 pillars (metrics/logs/traces). The standard lens for performance and incident diagnosis.
skills.description_zh: 依据指标、日志及追踪推断系统内部状态，结合 USE、RED 和 Google SRE 四个黄金信号进行性能及事故诊断。

skills.name: owasp-security
skills.description: OWASP Top 10 — the 10 most critical web application security risks. SQL Injection, XSS, broken auth, security misconfiguration, and more. Essential checklist for every web app, especially for non-developers using AI to build apps.
headings: A08 — Software and Data Integrity Failures
A09 — Security Logging and Monitoring Failures
skills.description_zh: 以 OWASP Top 10 为框架检查 SQL 注入、XSS、认证和配置等 Web 风险，特别面向使用 AI 构建应用的非开发者。具体版本和完整清单以原资料及当前标准核对。

skills.name: resilience-patterns
skills.description: Resilience Patterns — Circuit Breaker·Bulkhead·Back-pressure·Rate Limiting·Retry with jitter·Timeout. Based on Nygard's *Release It!* Keep external dependency failures from dragging your service down.
headings: Korean Finance and Payment Field Patterns
What to Use Alongside This Framework
skills.description_zh: 依据 Release It! 的韧性模式设计断路器、舱壁、背压、限流、抖动重试和超时，降低外部依赖故障对服务的拖累。

skills.name: scientific-debugging
skills.description: Scientific Debugging — hypothesis-driven debugging. Treat bugs not as mysteries but as a chain of falsifiable hypotheses. Observation→Hypothesis→Experiment→Verification loop. Based on Zeller's *Why Programs Fail*.
headings: Key: *Start with experiments that have the lowest falsification cost*
skills.description_zh: 按观察、假设、实验、验证循环进行科学调试，将故障拆为可证伪假设，依据 Why Programs Fail 的方法定位问题。

skills.name: solid
skills.description: SOLID Principles (Robert Martin) — SRP/OCP/LSP/ISP/DIP. Classic principles of OO design. Includes warnings against over-application. References Dan North's CUPID alternative.
headings: Situations Where SOLID Becomes the *Primary* Framework (Not Architectural Level)
Frameworks to Use Alongside This One
skills.description_zh: 应用面向对象 SOLID 的单一职责、开闭、里氏替换、接口隔离和依赖倒置原则，同时提示过度使用风险并参考 CUPID 替代思路。

skills.name: strangler-fig
skills.description: Strangler Fig Pattern (Martin Fowler) — don't rip out legacy all at once; grow a new system around it and replace it gradually. Includes Branch by Abstraction and Parallel Change. The alternative to failed rewrites.
headings: What to Use Alongside This Framework
skills.description_zh: 使用绞杀者模式围绕遗留系统逐步构建和替换，结合抽象分支及并行变更，避免一次性整体重写。

skills.name: team-topologies
skills.description: Team Topologies (Skelton & Pais) — 4 team types + 3 interaction modes + cognitive load + Inverse Conway Maneuver. Team structure shapes architecture. For team scaling, platformization, and microservices organization design.
headings: Common Failures in Korean Organizational Context
skills.description_zh: 依据 Team Topologies 的四类团队、三种互动模式、认知负荷和逆康威策略分析组织与架构，适用于团队扩张、平台化及微服务组织设计。

skills.name: twelve-factor
skills.description: Twelve-Factor App (Adam Wiggins, Heroku) — the 12 principles for cloud-native apps. Baseline hygiene for deployment, operations, and scaling. Check along 12 axes: config, dependencies, port binding, logs, processes, and more.
skills.description_zh: 按 Twelve-Factor App 十二原则检查云应用配置、依赖、端口、日志、进程等部署运维和扩展基础。
